description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) network interface, specifically for VR9 hardware. It includes core functions for initializing, configuring, and managing the PTM device, handling network packet transmission and reception, interrupt handling, and device setup/teardown.

methods.name: ptm_showtime_enter
methods.description: Enables showtime mode, sets device carrier on, and configures hardware registers.

methods.name: ptm_showtime_exit
methods.description: Disables showtime mode, turns off device carrier, and resets hardware registers.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, allocates network devices, registers IRQs, and starts the hardware.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters devices, and stops the hardware.

methods.name: ptm_setup
methods.description: Configures network device parameters and MAC address.

methods.name: ptm_get_stats
methods.description: Returns network statistics for the device.

methods.name: ptm_open
methods.description: Starts network device operation, enables NAPI, and interrupts.

methods.name: ptm_stop
methods.description: Stops network device operation, disables NAPI, and interrupts.

methods.name: ptm_poll
methods.description: Handles packet reception in NAPI polling.

methods.name: ptm_napi_poll
methods.description: NAPI poll function that calls ptm_poll and manages interrupt masking.

methods.name: ptm_hard_start_xmit
methods.description: Transmits a packet by preparing descriptors and updating hardware.

methods.name: ptm_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for retrieving and setting device parameters.

methods.name: ptm_tx_timeout
methods.description: Handles transmission timeout, disables TX interrupts, and wakes queue.

methods.name: alloc_skb_rx
methods.description: Allocates a receive buffer skb with proper alignment.

methods.name: alloc_skb_tx
methods.description: Allocates a transmit buffer skb with proper alignment.

methods.name: get_skb_pointer
methods.description: Retrieves skb pointer from a dataptr.

methods.name: get_tx_desc
methods.description: Gets a free transmit descriptor for sending packets.

methods.name: mailbox_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for mailbox events, schedules NAPI or tasklets.

methods.name: do_swap_desc_tasklet
methods.description: Handles swap descriptors in a tasklet, re-allocates buffers.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_version
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version info.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Initializes private data structures and configuration.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Clears private data structures.

methods.name: init_tables
methods.description: Initializes hardware descriptors and configuration tables.

methods.name: clear_tables
methods.description: Frees allocated buffers and clears descriptors.
